derivation:
by
  change (Valued.v a.1 ≤ 1 ∧ Valued.v (↑(a⁻¹)) ≤ 1) ↔ _
  rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, ← Valuation.one_le_val_iff _ a.ne_zero, ← le_antisymm_iff]
explanation: Instantiate the valuation with Valued.v on the adic completion. Units membership unfolds to two valuation inequalities; the declaration converts the inverse inequality to the opposite inequality, and antisymmetry gives equality to one.
